name: Inspo Generator
description: Procedural decoration engine: decorate your layout in many styles, generate structures and roll backgrounds.

harmony.name: Color harmony
harmony.description: How the accent color relates to the base color.

layout.name: Structure type
layout.description: Mix, a set (futuristic / classic), or one type.

motion.name: Motion
motion.description: static = no animation, ambient = spin/bob/pulse, full = plus particles, flicker and swaying.

bpm.name: Song BPM
bpm.description: Pulses, flashes and the circles effect sync to this tempo.

background.name: Generate background
background.description: Sky gradient, stars, moon, silhouettes, fog and motes.

bg-style.name: Background type
bg-style.description: Used by Inspire and BG Dice. Random rolls a different type each time.

parallax.name: Parallax background
parallax.description: Background layers follow the player at different speeds.

entrance.name: Entrance animations
entrance.description: Structures rise / drop into place as the player approaches.

start-at-level-begin.name: Start loops at level start
start-at-level-begin.description: If off, animations start just before the batch instead.

seed.name: Seed
seed.description: Leave empty for random. Any number or word reproduces the same batch.

recolor-keeps-theme.name: Recolor keeps theme
recolor-keeps-theme.description: If off, Recolor picks from all themes.

editor-preview-colors.name: Show colors in editor
editor-preview-colors.description: Writes the palette into the level's start colors so the editor shows them immediately.

group-start.name: Lowest group ID
group-start.description: Batches always start above the highest group already used in the level.

deco-color-start.name: First color channel (Decorate)
deco-color-start.description: Layout decoration uses 23 channels from here, separate from scenes.

solid-id.name: Solid square object ID
solid-id.description: Object used for all shapes. Must be a plain, colorable square.
